#### Key Findings:

**Conceptual Issues:**
1. No hyperparameters specified for BERT fine-tuning (ideal: lr=2e-5, batch=16, epochs=3-4)

5. Stopwords removal NOT recommended for IndoBERTweet (degrades performance)
